data.name: Alcatraz Tour Package
data.headline: Combined Alcatraz admission with choice of bike rental, hop-on hop-off bus, or bay cruise for a flexible San Francisco experience.
data.description: Visit Alcatraz Island with ferry admission from Pier 33 and explore the cellhouse using an award-winning 45-minute audio tour available in multiple languages. Choose a package that pairs the Alcatraz visit with either a self-guided bike rental (up to two days), a hop-on hop-off bus ticket, or a 60-minute San Francisco Bay cruise. The experience combines history, waterfront views, and flexible add-ons for a full day of sightseeing in San Francisco.
data.highlights:
* Explore the historic Alcatraz cellhouse with an award-winning audio tour
* Choose between biking, a hop-on hop-off bus, or a scenic bay cruise to customize your day
* See iconic sights like the Golden Gate Bridge, Fisherman’s Wharf, and downtown San Francisco
data.what_is_included:
Admission to Alcatraz Island and ferry from Pier 33
A 45-minute award-winning audio tour in multiple languages
Visit inside the Alcatraz prison cells
Up to 2 days of bicycle use with helmet, lock, and biking map (bike package)
One-day unlimited hop-on hop-off bus ticket (bus package)
60-minute San Francisco Bay Cruise (bay cruise package)

data.cancellation_notes: All sales are final. No refund, exchange, or cancellation on Alcatraz packages.
data.booking_notes:
You will receive all tour tickets and instructions in a separate email shortly.

Alcatraz Tour Address: Pier 33, San Francisco
data.check_in_details: Meeting point for Alcatraz ferry: Pier 33 (Alcatraz Landing). Bus tour starting point: 99 Jefferson St. Bus hours 10:00 am to 5:00 pm with departures every 15–30 minutes. Bike rental pickup: 1465 Lombard Street, hours 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. You will receive tickets and further instructions by email after booking.
data.extras: Option to upgrade to electric bikes for an additional $50 per person; option to upgrade hop-on hop-off to 2-day for an additional $20 per person.
data.disclaimers: Packages combine activities operated by different tour agencies; you will receive ticketing instructions by email after booking. Bay Cruise tickets are valid for any day and have multiple daily departures. Alcatraz departure times are from Pier 33; exact departure time is to be determined. Allow at least 3 hours to visit Alcatraz Island, complete the audio tour, explore exhibits, and return by ferry.
